scenario.title: New patient appointment
scenario.situation: You need a routine new-patient checkup. Prefer next Tuesday afternoon; flexible.
scenario.objective: Find a real available slot, learn what to bring, and confirm the details.
scenario.probes: Ask the location and whether this is a booking or a request awaiting confirmation.
scenario.expected: Collects required details, offers availability, accurately states booking status.
